findings.evidence: `PrefixDeletion.lean:431` exposes only the indicator projection, while `PrefixDeletion.lean:468-470` constructs `h_CI : CondIndep ...` privately; downstream `BlockFactorization.lean:124-129` requires `iCondIndepFun ...` hypotheses, so the characteristic API needed to bridge this lemma into later finite-product factorization is missing.
findings.fix: Add a public theorem, e.g. `Contractable.condIndep_Xr_prefix_tail`, returning `CondIndep (comap W) (comap (X r)) (comap U) ...`, and derive the conditional-expectation projection from it; make the needed conditional-independence import public if it appears in the signature.
findings.issue: `Contractable.condExp_Xr_indicator_eq` is the only public theorem even though the docstring says it is equivalent to conditional independence; the actual `CondIndep` object is built only as private proof state at lines 468-470.

summary: The public surface exposes only the projected conditional-expectation identity, but the file proves and documents the stronger conditional-independence statement that downstream DeFinetti code actually consumes. Expose the characteristic `CondIndep` API instead of making consumers reconstruct it from the projection theorem.
